en.title: The Next Step for Robot Foundation Models: Adaptation, Reasoning, and Real-World Evaluation
en.summary: A first-principles look at robot foundation models: why deployment depends on cheap policy adaptation, interfaces that turn VLM reasoning into low-level control, and real-world evaluation infrastructure.
